title: Agent triage
blurb: Files recent inbox mail into your Brain categories and stacks todos. A successful Reply or Reply All completes only the Needs You todo recorded when that reply starts. Forward, a new message, a saved draft, a canceled compose, a failed send, and a queued or scheduled send leave that todo open until the send succeeds. Mark as read leaves it open. The Settings opt-in "Mark as read also completes Agent todos" is off by default. Mark read & done marks the message read and completes the todo. Explicit reads wait for mailbox confirmation before completing a todo or counting for Learned; failed, unknown, superseded, and unattempted operations do not count. Pending decisions show why an item needs attention, its mailbox, read state and a clear subject deadline if present. Security decisions apply to this message in the current window only; Not me remains unresolved. Open source uses the exact account and message. Decisions never change mail, create rules or send replies. The sticky selection bar spans categories and mailboxes. Mark selected as read never completes a todo; archive separately reviews the exact selected mailbox scope, excludes conversation expansion and refuses unresolved selections. Latest batch receipts show each completed, pending, failed, unknown or unattempted action. Undo only reverses changes made by the batch. Already-read messages stay read. Reply-pile selection retains Complete selected. FYI and Other still offer a whole-category Mark as read shortcut that does not complete todos. Done and Dismiss stay on this computer. The Todos switcher includes List and Card. When multiple mailboxes are connected, Needs You shows the address of each item's connected receiving mailbox in List and on the Card face. Card shows the sender, subject, one Agent reason line, and Reply and Done. Hover, Tab focus, or a tap opens the same detail: a fuller summary, the classification reason, one thread line, and Reply, Done, and Dismiss. Escape or leaving the card dismisses it. The page header does not repeat that detail. Opening the detail does not open the message or complete the todo. Settings → Learned lists explicit moves among Needs You, FYI, and Other, repeated Mark as read or a successful reply for one sender or thread, and opened or dismissed suggestion labels. Replies in any category can count after non-partial delivery, even without an open todo. Thread hints also appear for multi-sender threads. The same pattern is Learned after 3 times. Delete removes that pattern and its count and refreshes suggestions in open conversations, skills, and proposals. After a temporary loading error, a successful read restores the list and Delete. Learned rows stay on this computer and do not rewrite Brain categories, triage prompts, or mailbox rules, and they do not send mail or move it. Conversation triage and mail cards use the same Learned suppression and Delete restoration. Peek Retry download stays in peek without marking read or changing Mail selection. Unsaved standing notes survive background refresh and page reopen; save replies preserve newer typing. IMAP filing remains visible while its journal receipt is pending, confirms only a matching completed move, and keeps failed or uncertain outcomes for review. Uncertain filing is not retried automatically; check the message in Mail. Unchanged cards and transcript turns stay in place during refresh; card details populate when opened. Skills load on the Tools tab, not as part of opening Todos. Learned settings load only when their General content is visible.
